digest.component_or_area: Pydantic Agent run structured output and usage accounting
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregate usage (sum of all attempts) exactly once in memory, telemetry, and durable JSONL without per-attempt rows or attempt-count fields.
Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain through ToolRetryError and ModelRetry.
Repeated-truncation/concision exhaustion with no Rebar object on the cause chain must fall back to constructing a fresh UnretryableOutputError.
Terminal-failure artifacts must capture the complete final provider response only when artifact capture is enabled, without mutating earlier retry-wire omitted messages.
Failure diagnostics must preserve consumed requests, tool calls, and provider-reported tokens without creating fictional usage values for calls that reported none.
Existing historical rows and pricing compatibility must be retained with no new core usage fields or competing request-budget fields introduced.
